title: List only declared wagons in a train

facts.note: Any non-excluded plan artifact declaring a train (with a `wagons:` list) or a `wagon:<slug>` is in scope, whether or not it changed; recognizable by file kind / plan structure.
The planner_plan_integrity validator scans every non-excluded train and reports wagons that resolve to no `wagon:<slug>` declaration, including pre-existing unresolved references in unchanged plans.

values: train wagons list added or edited
facts.note: Optional, for early warning only: a diff-level observer could flag edits that are likely to introduce an unresolved reference. Not a prerequisite for the rule to apply.

fires: Checking any non-excluded train plan, including an unchanged one, whose `wagons:` list already names a slug with no matching `wagon:<slug>` declaration.
A planner edits only a wagon's content in a plan where some train already lists an undeclared wagon slug — the pre-existing unresolved reference is still a finding.
A planner adds a wagon slug to a train's `wagons:` list without a matching `wagon:<slug>` declaration in the plan.
A planner renames or deletes a wagon declaration while a train still lists the old slug.
A train lists a wagon slug with a typo that matches no declared wagon.
doesNotFire: Every slug in every non-excluded train's `wagons:` list has a matching `wagon:<slug>` declaration.
Plan-like files inside vendored or generated trees (`node_modules`, `dist`, `build`, `_generated`).

Edits to a wagon's content that keep its `wagon:<slug>` declaration, provided every train wagon reference in the scanned plans resolves to a declared wagon (pre-existing unresolved references still fire).

given: A non-excluded plan contains a train whose `wagons:` list names wagon slugs (changed or not).
when: The plan is authored, edited or checked — e.g. a train's `wagons:` list is written, a wagon declaration is renamed/removed, or existing plans are validated.
then: Every wagon the train lists under `wagons:` is declared as `wagon:<slug>`.
prefer: Or remove the wagon from the train.
When renaming or removing a wagon declaration, update every train that lists it in the same change.
avoid: Listing a wagon in a train that has no `wagon:<slug>` declaration — a train ordering a wagon that does not exist cannot run.
Declaring an empty placeholder wagon solely to silence the check instead of planning the wagon or removing it from the train.
unless: Vendored and generated trees (`node_modules`, `dist`, `build`, `_generated`) are never scanned.
why: A train ordering a wagon that does not exist cannot run. Wagon membership is the train-specific case of reference resolution.
evidence: The planner_plan_integrity validator reports no unresolved train wagon across all non-excluded plans.
For each slug in each train's `wagons:` list, a reviewer finds a matching `wagon:<slug>` declaration.
The rule has a failing fixture (train listing an undeclared wagon) that the package guard rejects.
verifier_detail: Implementation: validator `planner_plan_integrity` (package guard, not a canonical planner node).

Resolution: each entry under a train's `wagons:` must match a declared `wagon:<slug>`; any unmatched entry is a finding. Applies to every scanned train, not only changed ones; pre-existing unresolved references are findings regardless of what the current edit touched.
